requirement_satisfaction.criteria: Fraction of outputs (failure_mechanism, lock_state_diagram, mitigations, unresolved_edge_cases) delivered.

source_fidelity.criteria: Fidelity to SQLite WAL locking mechanics (WAL index, write-ahead log frames, single writer invariant).

continuity.criteria: 1 if inquiry tracks preceding hypotheses and experiments; 0 if inquiry starts from blank slate.

useful_novelty.criteria: Identification of non-obvious failure modes (e.g. passive checkpoint vs truncate checkpoint starvation).

correction_burden.criteria: Number of factual or architectural errors requiring operator correction.

reconstruction_burden.criteria: Effort to reconstruct research context and prior experiments.

execution_overhead.criteria: Overhead units (0 for direct prompt, higher for mediated workflow execution).

recovery.criteria: 1 if research workflow survives interruption and resumes at active hypothesis; 0 otherwise.

forbidden_bias: Condition A (raw LLM) may outperform Condition E in execution overhead. Ties are valid.
